name: execution-trace
title: Execution Trace
description: Step through a trace with the active line and live variable values.
usage: <ExecutionTrace code={["let x = 2", "x *= 3"]} steps={[{ line: 1, variables: { x: 2 } }, { line: 2, variables: { x: 6 } }]} />
useCases: When studying a loop, a student steps through the trace and follows the counter beside the highlighted line.
When explaining a bug, an instructor goes back to the step where a variable first acquired the wrong value.
task: Step through a trace with the active line and live variable values.

models.Frame: type Frame = { line: number; variables: Record<string, string | number> };

behavior: code contains the source lines. Each step uses a one-based line number and a variables snapshot for that step.
